definitions.first_evaluation_candidate: No earlier evaluation or hoisted metric-state construction identified in selected adapter. Candidate for resident-input first-call comparison, subject to runtime baseline declaration, exact output/ingress and successful paired acquisition. Not an empirically qualified ratio.
definitions.pre_evaluated: The emitted COLD is already primed by earlier full pair evaluations; cannot compare to unprimed native cold.
definitions.cold_not_emitted: Adapter executes but suppresses first timing. No existing COLD observation is available.
definitions.resident_setup_excluded: Canonical first evaluation excludes scorer/configuration/model parameter construction/loading included in construction-inclusive native semantics or otherwise required for full scorer startup. Treat as resident-setup first evaluation, not full cold.
definitions.precreated_thread_runner: Metric evaluation is first, but canonical JXL thread runner setup is outside timer; strict runtime-inclusive native first-call equivalence is not established.
definitions.parameter_io_scope_mismatch: True first evaluation with declared SDR ingress; timed spectral-parameter I/O requires explicit matched scope before cold ratios.

native_contract.description: Fresh process, raw RGB image files loaded before timer; make_call construction plus one evaluation inside cold_call; no warmup. Runtime startup not uniformly hoisted; closure/scorer destruction follows elapsed capture. No OS-cache flush.

findings.title: NIQE COLD follows two untimed pair evaluations
findings.finding: The original-loader score at line 68 and resident-loader score at line 70 run before line 78 starts the first labeled timer. The emitted value is a third pair evaluation, not an unprimed cold call. This is the only explicit same-process scoring precheck identified among the selected 84-route adapters.

findings.title: Two libjxl routes have no COLD output
findings.finding: butteraugli and proposal-butteraugli both select rgb-input. The adapter times iteration zero but if(i) suppresses its output. First SAMPLE is already after one complete evaluation. Do not treat it as COLD.

findings.title: Six VMAF model routes include model parsing only on native first call
findings.finding: Frozen model-preload overlay caches after first construction; it does not eagerly prime models before native cold. new_uncached parses JSON on the first new call. Canonical model_load is before the loop. Existing warm model parity does not imply cold boundary equality. Auxiliary libvmaf routes do not load this model.

findings.title: Resident setup differs from scorer-construction cold
findings.finding: CVVDP, IW-SSIM, IW-SSIM-PIQ, NLPD, NLPD-IQA and DSSIM preconstruct canonical objects. BRISQUE loads immutable weights before timing and clones them inside. These are first evaluations with resident setup, not full construction-inclusive cold observations. Constructors in inspected NLPD/IW sources do not score an input.

findings.title: Runtime startup and output teardown require explicit scope
findings.finding: SSIMULACRA2 canonical runner is created before timing. Python adapters configure/import runtimes outside timing while native runtime first-use can occur inside cold. Native cold_call measures make()+one call, then records elapsed before closure destruction; it is not a complete create/evaluate/destroy lifecycle or process startup timer. Most per-call temporary outputs are released inside the closure.

findings.title: AIC2026 SDR aliases: cold parameter-I/O scope unresolved
findings.finding: Both AIC2026 aliases are campaign-included RGB8 SDR routes: canonical_hdrvdp_cell.py declares 200-nit linearization, fixed ppd, and v3 10-bit quantization/XYZ conversion. Their first evaluation includes spectral-parameter file I/O, so construction-inclusive resident-parameter cold scope is not yet matched. Base hdrvdp/hdrvdp3 typed absolute-luminance limitations remain separate and unchanged.

findings.title: Warm plan acceptance cannot qualify a cold ratio
findings.finding: compare_canonical sets timing_phase=warm and parses only SAMPLE rows; matched_scope is a warm contract. No cold ratios are established by this review. Many absolute_bound values are null; no fresh numerical pass may be inferred.

findings.title: Resident NN first evaluation remains a different protocol
findings.finding: resident_nn_first builds Rayon and primes immutable model construction before cold_call, then checks a second evaluation after the timer. The second call before printing COLD does not contaminate the earlier measured first call. This is resident-model first evaluation and must not replace construction-inclusive native cold.

qualification: Static boundary review, not acquired first-call timing or parity acceptance
